design: 128 heldout single-token-input copy/task prompts: plural nouns, antonym adjectives, capitals countries, succession months. Same fixed signed coefficient probes and seed669 norm-matched random control as H669. Read current input, task answer and all seven other input identities in each8-item family. Full downstream computation; no fitting.
limitations: Existing repeatedly inspected panel, not new blind replication. Single random control direction, limited vocabulary. Finite effect of one head value direction, not whole-head necessity or general semantic algorithm.
